title: Capstone core: driver and client
description:
Build and test the shared protocol of a driver and client pair before writing any kernel code.

```
shared header: 3 IOCTLs, request and response structs, all static_assert'ed
client tests: 12 passed
driver-side validation tests: 18 passed (including 6 bad requests)
fuzzed the validator: 500,000 inputs, 0 failures
```
hints: Keeping kernel logic in plain functions is what lets you test most of a driver without a kernel (lesson 18.03).
Reuse the IOCTL, validation and fuzzing work from milestones 16 and 17.
requirements: One header with the codes and the structs, shared by both sides.
The driver's validation and handlers written as plain functions you can test in user mode.
Tests and a fuzzer for the validator, run before anything goes into a virtual machine.
stretch: Build the real driver around the tested functions and run the same client tests in the VM.
